g.text: Fewer buses, but routes exceed the battery range
All 14 proposed routes exceed the usable 80 kWh battery (dashed line).
Energy includes service trips and travel; depot departures are optimistically fully charged.
Four development cells; these failures concern the selected routes only.
They do not establish that every fleet with three or four buses is infeasible.
